hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Multiple wide travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming encourage high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which would make pedestrians nearly invisible to drivers at night.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible across this four-lane road, making crossing dangerous.

hazards.name: No Sidewalk Buffer
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the right is immediately adjacent to high-speed traffic with no physical separation.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is located in the center of the sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians and people using mobility devices.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide, uncontrolled driveway entrance to the bank parking lot creates a large area where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the sidewalk meets the parking lot entrance

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four travel lanes and two wide shoulders without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for the adjacent parking lot create numerous conflict points between pedestrians and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side sidewalk and parking lot entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk on either side of the roadway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the road shoulder.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds adjacent to pedestrian paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: No public sidewalks are present, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or the paved shoulder immediately adjacent to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: High-Speed Arterial Design
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, significantly increasing the risk of fatality in a collision.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Driveway
hazards.description: The driveway entrance is exceptionally wide, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to turning vehicles without any markings to indicate their right of way.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image where sidewalk meets the parking lot entrance.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: The large commercial pylon sign and parked vehicles near the entrance can block the view between drivers turning into the lot and pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the driveway entrance.

hazards.name: High-speed vehicle environment
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway design and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds adjacent to the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right of the image, the main roadway.

hazards.name: Frequent conflict points
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is directly adjacent to a large parking lot with wide, poorly defined vehicle access points.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, where the sidewalk meets the parking lot.

hazards.name: High-Speed Multi-Lane Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, four-lane configuration with a median encourages high vehicle speeds without any pedestrian protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are visible for a long distance, making crossing extremely dangerous.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible frame

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Driveway Access
hazards.description: The gas station has wide, undefined entry and exit points that create multiple conflict zones for anyone walking along the shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the gas station frontage

hazards.name: Blank building frontage
hazards.description: The windowless side of the commercial building reduces natural surveillance and creates a less comfortable pedestrian experience.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Openings
hazards.description: Large, undefined commercial driveways on the left create frequent conflict points where vehicles may turn across the pedestrian path at speed.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The multi-lane road lacks any marked crossings, requiring pedestrians to cross over 60 feet of high-speed traffic without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the travel lanes

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: Wide curb cuts for the gas station create multiple points where vehicles cross the sidewalk, increasing the risk of collisions.

hazards.name: Excessive Driveway Width
hazards.description: The driveway entrance is extremely wide, creating a long, unprotected exposure period for pedestrians crossing the vehicle path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, where the sidewalk is interrupted by the asphalt driveway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Utility Pole
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned near the sidewalk edge, potentially obscuring sight lines between pedestrians and vehicles exiting the gas station.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, adjacent to the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk on the shoulder or unpaved grass.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large box truck at the intersection obscures visibility between pedestrians and other drivers.

hazards.name: Wide gas station apron
hazards.description: The extremely wide vehicle entrance creates a long, unprotected conflict zone where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right area where the sidewalk meets the gas station lot

hazards.name: Undefined Driveway Access
hazards.description: The large asphalt area for the commercial strip on the left lacks defined entry/exit points, creating unpredictable vehicle movements across potential pedestrian paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the commercial frontage

hazards.name: Debris in Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: A fallen sign or post is lying in the grass area adjacent to the roadway, creating a trip hazard for anyone walking along the shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: In the grass on the near side of the road, right of center.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or physical barrier between the roadway and the area where pedestrians are expected to walk, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edge of the roadway where it meets the grass.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the physical and psychological distance from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow vehicle speeds and repurpose space for pedestrian buffers or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, shortening the pedestrian crossing distance and slowing turning speeds.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and alert drivers they are crossing a walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planter Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or bollards between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway and use tighter curb radii to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for pedestrian and bicycle facilities.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale and roadway lighting to improve visibility and safety during dark hours.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the roadway to provide a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or into a new buffer zone to ensure a continuous, unobstructed clear path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of driveway entrances to minimize conflict points and improve sidewalk continuity.

interventions.title: Signalized Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian-actuated signal to provide a safe, protected crossing point.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Crossing
interventions.description: Continuing the sidewalk at its current grade across the driveway to slow entering vehicles and reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding bold pavement markings across the driveway to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing painted bike lane to a protected bike lane using physical barriers to provide a buffer for both cyclists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility of pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island in the existing median.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk on both sides of the street, separated from traffic by a planting strip.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and pedestrian-activated signals or RRFBs to facilitate safe crossing of the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Curbing
interventions.description: Define gas station access points with concrete curbs and narrow the driveway widths to reduce vehicle speeds and conflict areas.

interventions.title: Street trees
interventions.description: Planting trees in the grass buffer would provide shade and help visually narrow the roadway to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Adding lighting specifically for the sidewalk would improve safety and comfort during evening hours.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the median and high-visibility signage or RRFBs.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and reduce the overall crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Construct a raised crossing across the driveway to maintain sidewalk level and priority, forcing vehicles to slow down when entering or exiting.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint across the driveway to clearly delineate the pedestrian path and signal priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Enhanced Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the median and a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) or HAWK signal.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime or low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Utilize the existing grass median to create hardscaped pedestrian refuge islands at future crossing locations.

interventions.title: Access Management
interventions.description: Consolidate and define driveway entrances for the commercial area to reduce the number of conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Construct Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Provide ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the crosswalk to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Add Curb and Gutter
interventions.description: Install a raised curb to physically separate the roadway from the pedestrian area and improve drainage.
